title: Aircover Pipeline — summary.json (v1.0)
description: Run summary written to <output-dir>/summary.json at the end of each pipeline invocation.

schema_version.description: Version of the output schema family. Bumped on breaking changes.

package_version.description: Version of the aircover-pipeline package that produced this output (e.g., '1.0.1'). Helpful for audit trails when reproducing or troubleshooting a run.

ran_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the run completed.

base_url.description: API base URL used for this run (e.g., production vs staging).

filters.description: The exact filter arguments applied to this run. Useful when reproducing a result or diffing across runs.

dry_run.description: true when invoked with --dry-run. The success/failed/processed_this_run fields will be absent in dry-run summaries.

template_id.description: Coaching template id this run was executed against.

meetings_in_window.description: Total candidate meetings for the date range after --exclude-domains / --filter-emails / --filter-teams are applied. Captured BEFORE --resume and --limit pruning, so this is the size of the filtered population, not the number actually processed in this run.

processed_this_run.description: Meetings the script attempted to process in this invocation (excludes rows skipped via --resume). Absent in --dry-run summaries.

success.description: Meetings with a successful agent output written. Absent in --dry-run summaries.

failed.description: Meetings whose coaching call failed. See failures.json for details. Absent in --dry-run summaries.

skipped_resume.description: Meetings skipped because an agent-output file already existed (set when --resume is used). Absent in --dry-run summaries.
